Find the full update log ingame

HALLOWEEN UPDATE
Code: HALLOWEEN2026

WITCH AKARI RAID IS BACK AFTER 5 YEARS - Ends Nov 8
Witch Akari has been buffed to be in line with other raid characters
New Mythic Witch Akari Card has been added
Halloween Lobby has been added back in
All old Halloween Limited costumes are back on sale

EXTREME DIMENSION REVAMP
Entry limit has been removed. Instead rewards slowly decrease the more runs are done. Resets every day.
Enemy health and damage has been lowered significantly
Revives are available if you die out in Extreme Dimension

Other Features:
Players can store and use up to 3 dashes in a row now
UI has been completely revamped to be cleaner but still familiar to the old one
Divine Core has been added to the Raid Shop
Fruits and Pets can be sold for Gems
Accessories can be sold for Raid Tokens
Auto Roll Traits Feature
